basis: Brain, oral and digital malformations define OFD14. Cardiac defects occur in 30-79%; retinal coloboma, epiglottic and urethral defects also meet frequency thresholds but exceed the cap.

decisions.cardiovascular: involved: PDA and VSD are annotated at 30-79%; potentially serious cardiac malformations receive the remaining slot under the four-axis cap.
decisions.ocular: none: retinal coloboma occurs in 30-79%, but is omitted under the four-axis cap in favor of cardiac malformations.

basis: TAP2 antigen-presentation immunodeficiency with defining chronic granulomatous skin ulcers; chronic bronchiectatic airway damage commonly exceeds 30%. Metabolic ancestry is misleading.

decisions.pulmonary: involved: chronic destructive airway disease and bronchiectasis affect >30% over the usual course, beyond isolated episodes of respiratory infection.
decisions.dermatologic: primary: nonhealing ulcerative granulomatous skin lesions are a defining disease manifestation.
decisions.metabolic_endocrine: none: TAP2 deficiency impairs antigen presentation; the supplied metabolic classification does not establish a metabolic disorder.

basis: Blistering and muscular dystrophy define disease; ocular motor impairment is annotated at 80-99%, enamel defects at 30-79%. Language annotations are discordant with established EBS-MD.

decisions.gastrointestinal: involved: dental enamel abnormalities are annotated at 30-79%; teeth belong to the gastrointestinal axis.
decisions.neurologic: none: aphasia/echolalia annotations conflict with established EBS-MD; myopathic ocular weakness does not establish separate neurologic damage.

basis: Noninfectious immune-mediated chorioretinal inflammation causes atrophic scars, neovascularization and visual loss.

decisions.infectious_immune: primary: punctate inner choroidopathy is a noninfectious inflammatory chorioretinopathy within the immune-mediated posterior uveitis spectrum.

basis: Vitreoretinal degeneration and occipital encephalocele with calvarial defects define the syndrome; encephalocele and skull defects are annotated at 80-99%.

decisions.musculoskeletal: primary: the occipital calvarial defect underlying the characteristic encephalocele is a defining structural feature, annotated at 80-99%.

basis: Hereditary TTR protein deposition with neuropathy; cardiac infiltration commonly exceeds 30% across variants; sensorineural hearing loss occurs in 2/4 supplied cases, a limited sample.

decisions.metabolic_endocrine: primary: hereditary transthyretin amyloidosis is an inherited disorder of protein folding and metabolism producing systemic amyloid deposition.

basis: Thiamine deficiency produces metabolic brain injury with encephalopathy and persistent amnesia; ocular motor signs reflect neurologic dysfunction.

decisions.metabolic_endocrine: primary: defining thiamine deficiency disrupts cerebral energy metabolism; this is a nutritional metabolic encephalopathy.

basis: Milk-induced pulmonary hypersensitivity with hemosiderosis and defining anemia; digestive bleeding is explicitly characteristic in the supplied definition, although no numeric frequency is given.

decisions.haematologic: primary: characteristic blood-loss/iron-deficiency anemia is a defining component of the pulmonary hemosiderosis syndrome.
decisions.gastrointestinal: involved: digestive bleeding is explicitly a defining manifestation in the supplied definition; it represents mucosal injury rather than a nonspecific symptom.

basis: Inherited blistering and poikiloderma; gingivitis and premature tooth loss occur in 80-99%, structural skull abnormalities in 30-79%. Damaging ocular findings occur in only 5-29%.

decisions.musculoskeletal: involved: turricephaly and abnormal skull morphology are annotated at 30-79%, supporting permanent structural skeletal involvement.

basis: Immune-mediated cutaneous granulomas; pulmonary involvement from the same systemic sarcoid process occurs in roughly 50-70% of cutaneous cases, despite some remaining skin-limited.

decisions.pulmonary: involved: pulmonary granulomatous disease accompanies roughly 50-70% of cutaneous cases and reflects the same sarcoid process; involvement need not be universal.
